build_frcnn_model_from_pretrained: build a GeneralizedRCNN model from a pretrained checkpoint using from_pretrained with a config path
run_frcnn_inference: run object detection inference on images using GeneralizedRCNN to get boxes, classes, and ROI features
build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone network from a config using build_backbone with specified depth and norm
create_box2box_transform: create a Box2BoxTransform to compute deltas between source and target bounding boxes for regression
generate_rpn_anchors: generate anchors for region proposal using AnchorGenerator with configurable sizes and aspect ratios
